meta.title: Sequence Diagram — Multi-Channel Ingestion & Full AI Synthesis Pipeline
meta.subtitle: From PDF Upload / SSRF URL / Vision OCR to Synthesis, Gap Detection, Knowledge Graph Construction & SQLite Persistence

participants.label: Researcher
participants.explanation: Uploads PDFs, submits public links, captures document scans, and clicks Run Full AI Synthesis Pipeline.

participants.label: Dashboard UI
participants.explanation: Coordinates ingestion tabs and runs the sequential 4-step synthesis, gap, graph, and save pipeline.

participants.label: Ingest / OCR
participants.explanation: Runs PyMuPDF text parsing, SSRF URL firewall, Laplacian blur checks, and invisible-text OCR PDF assembly.

participants.label: AI Gateway
participants.explanation: Executes generate_structured_json() with schema binding, retries, and fallback model progression.

participants.label: Gap & Map
participants.explanation: Produces ResearchGapReport matrices and builds NetworkX structural or semantic concept graphs.

participants.label: Gemini API
participants.explanation: Processes multimodal OCR frames and multi-document structured JSON synthesis prompts.

participants.label: SQLite & Disk
participants.explanation: Persists SHA-256 PDFs and sanitized user-scoped research_sessions rows.

cards.title: Hybrid Fast + AI Graph Strategy
items: The Dashboard one-click pipeline uses build_structural_graph_data() so every node clusters cleanly without extra LLM latency.
Inside pages/knowledge_map.py, researchers can optionally invoke extract_ai_knowledge_graph() for deeper semantic relations.

cards.title: Failure Resilience
items: Missing or exhausted Gemini models trigger _DAILY_EXHAUSTED_MODELS tracking and automatic model step-down rather than crashing the workspace.
